byPath.*: Plans one working day of sales outreach: prices a call, an email and an SMS for every prospect, respects the contact policy, and lets the MILP solver pick the channels with the largest expected revenue
byPath.Action: The channel chosen for one client, its time and its expected value
byPath.Client: One prospect: wealth, propensity to buy, preferred channel, consent and the days since the last contact
byPath.Task: An action on the schedule: the worker and the start of the action
byPath.Team: The sales team of the day: the number of workers and the working hours of each worker
byPath.allowedFlag: The offer as a bound for the solver: 1 when the policy allows the channel, else 0
byPath.campaign: The parameters of the campaign: the product revenue, the SMS gateway limit and the start of the day
byPath.channelOffer: One channel for one client: the probability to buy, and the expected revenue when the policy allows it
byPath.channelTerms: The time a channel takes and the lift: the share of clients it convinces to buy
byPath.channelTotals: The clients, the minutes and the expected revenue of one channel
byPath.clientAction: The channel the solver chose for a client, its time, its expected value and the reason
byPath.clientRecord: The client data, the tier, the offers of the three channels and the codes of every rule that blocks a channel
byPath.clockTime: The clock time a number of minutes after the start of the day, as HH:MM
byPath.contactBlocks: The contact policy: every rule that forbids the channel for this client, with the reason
byPath.contactMix: The optimisation: a 0/1 decision per client and channel, at most one action per client and no blocked channel, for the largest expected revenue within the time of the team and the SMS limit
byPath.contactPlan: Plans the outreach of one day: prices every channel for every client, lets the solver choose the channel of every client, and returns the action, the worker and the start time for every client
byPath.inWorkOrder: Orders the actions: longest first, then the largest expected value first
byPath.outreachBook: One working day for two workers and 100 prospects: the channel, the worker and the start time for every client, with the totals by channel and wealth tier
byPath.outreachBook.outreach: The contact plan: what to do with every client, and the totals by channel and tier
byPath.preferenceFit: How well a channel fits the preferred channel of the client: the preferred one convinces more, another less
byPath.tierTotals: The calls, emails, SMS and not contacted clients of one wealth tier
byPath.wealthTier: Puts a client into a wealth tier: private, premium, affluent or mass
byPath.workSchedule: Puts the actions on the workers, longest first, each on the worker who is free first. The channel times divide each other and the working day, so the plan always fits
